name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Create a national digital health ecosystem with interoperable health records through ABHA numbers and health facility and professional registries.

eligibility.criteria: All Indian residents can voluntarily create an ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number.

benefits.summary: Free ABHA number and digital health records
benefits.details: Consent-based sharing of health records across facilities, plus tele-consultation and e-prescription ecosystem.

application.steps: Create an ABHA number on the ABDM portal using Aadhaar or a mobile number, or at a participating health facility.

sources.title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission — official portal

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Mobilise ₹1 lakh crore for post-harvest and farm infrastructure.

eligibility.criteria: Eligible entities building post-harvest management and community farming assets.

benefits.details: On loans up to ₹2 crore for up to seven years, with CGTMSE credit guarantee.

application.steps: Apply on the AIF portal through a participating bank.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
objectives: Incentivise private investment in dairy, meat processing and feed plants.

eligibility.criteria: Eligible private players and MSMEs.

benefits.details: Credit guarantee of 25% of loan.

application.steps: Apply via the AHIDF portal.

sources.title: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund — official portal

name: AMRUT 2.0
aliases: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
objectives: Universal water supply and sewage coverage in statutory towns.

eligibility.criteria: Households in covered towns.

benefits.details: Tap connections and sewage treatment.

application.steps: Through urban local bodies.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
objectives: Provide a guaranteed minimum pension to subscribers, mainly workers in the unorganised sector, after they reach 60 years of age.

eligibility.criteria: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with a savings bank/post office account; not income-tax payers (as per scheme rules).

benefits.details: Pension begins at age 60, with the same amount paid to the spouse and corpus returned to nominees.

application.steps: Approach the bank/post office where you hold an account and submit the APY registration form.

sources.title: PFRDA / NPS Trust — Atal Pension Yojana

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Provide health cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to poor and vulnerable families, reducing catastrophic out-of-pocket medical expenditure.

eligibility.criteria: Families identified by the deprivation criteria of the 2011 Socio-Economic Caste Census, plus all senior citizens aged 70+ (extended 2024) irrespective of income.

benefits.summary: ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year
benefits.details: Cashless, paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals.

application.steps: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or via the Ayushman app, then visit an empanelled hospital to use the Ayushman Card.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (AB PM-JAY, 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Extend free health cover to all senior citizens aged 70 and above.

eligibility.criteria: All Indian citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income.

benefits.details: Family floater cover for 70+ households; senior members already under PM-JAY share the cover with an additional top-up.

application.steps: Apply for the Vay Vandana card on the PM-JAY portal or Ayushman app using Aadhaar eKYC.

sources.title: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card — official portal

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
objectives: Address the declining child sex ratio and promote the education and survival of the girl child through awareness and convergent action.

eligibility.criteria: Awareness and outreach apply universally; specific benefits are delivered through associated schemes and district-level interventions.

benefits.summary: Improved survival, protection and education of the girl child
benefits.details: Implemented through convergent action with education, health and district administration programmes.

application.steps: A mass awareness and convergent-action scheme; no individual application. Related benefits flow through linked schemes.

sources.title: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
objectives: Provide collateral-free credit guarantee to micro and small enterprises.

eligibility.criteria: Eligible MSEs seeking bank credit.

benefits.details: Guarantee cover for eligible loans, enhanced limit from 2025.

application.steps: Through member lending institutions.

sources.title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises — official portal

name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA)
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
objectives: Saturate tribal-majority villages with basic services and livelihood support.

eligibility.criteria: Tribal-majority villages and aspirational tribal districts.

benefits.details: Approx. ₹79,156 crore for housing, drinking water, healthcare, education and livelihood.

application.steps: Through the district administration.

sources.title: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan — official portal

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Reduce rural poverty through SHGs and sustainable livelihoods.

eligibility.criteria: Rural poor households, organised in SHGs.

benefits.details: Revolving funds, community investment support and interest subvention.

application.steps: Join an SHG via the state rural livelihood mission.

sources.title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission — official portal

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Provide placement-linked skills training to rural youth.

eligibility.criteria: Poor rural youth within the age limit.

benefits.details: Placement support and post-placement tracking.

application.steps: Through training partners or state missions.

sources.title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana — official portal

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)
ministry: Ministry of Power

eligibility.criteria: Rural areas.

benefits.details: Feeder separation and sub-transmission.

application.steps: Through DISCOMs.

sources.title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana — official portal

statusNote: Subsumed into the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme.

name: Digital India
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
objectives: Transform India into a digitally empowered society.

eligibility.criteria: All citizens.

benefits.details: DigiLocker, UMANG, broadband and e-governance.

application.steps: Use the Digital India services portal.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Create a unified online market for agricultural commodities.

eligibility.criteria: Farmers and traders registered with a mandi integrated with e-NAM.

benefits.details: Access to a pan-India market and online payments.

application.steps: Register on the e-NAM portal or at the mandi.

name: e-Shram
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
objectives: Create a national database of unorganised workers and link them to social security and welfare schemes.

eligibility.criteria: Unorganised workers aged 16–59, not members of EPFO/ESIC, including migrant, gig and platform workers.

benefits.summary: Universal Account Number and scheme access
benefits.details: Registered workers get an e-Shram card and access to social security schemes and accidental insurance.

application.steps: Self-register on the e-Shram portal with Aadhaar and bank details, or via a Common Service Centre.

name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
objectives: Provide quality residential education to ST children.

eligibility.criteria: ST children in Classes 6-12.

benefits.details: Quality education with hostel and facilities.

application.steps: Through entrance exams by the state tribal department.

sources.title: Eklavya Model Residential Schools — official portal

name: eSanjeevani
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Provide free telemedicine consultation.

eligibility.criteria: Any citizen.

benefits.details: Doctor-to-doctor and patient-to-doctor consultations.

application.steps: Use the eSanjeevani portal or app.

name: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
objectives: Provide nutrition, health and pre-school education to young children and mothers.

eligibility.criteria: Registered at Anganwadi centres.

benefits.details: Supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups and pre-school education.

application.steps: Through Anganwadi centres.

sources.title: Integrated Child Development Services — official portal

statusNote: Now implemented under Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0.

name: Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Provide houses to rural poor.

eligibility.criteria: Rural BPL families.

benefits.details: Discontinued after rebranding.

application.steps: Through Gram Panchayat.

name: New Central Sector Scheme for Industrial Development of Jammu and Kashmir
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
objectives: Promote industrial investment in J&K.

eligibility.criteria: New and existing units in J&K.

benefits.details: Reimbursements and subsidies.

application.steps: Through the scheme portal.

sources.title: New Central Sector Scheme for Industrial Development of Jammu and Kashmir — official portal

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
objectives: Provide safely managed and adequate drinking water through household tap connections in rural India.

eligibility.criteria: Rural households without a functional household tap connection; prioritised for water-scarce and quality-affected villages.

benefits.details: Assured potable water supply of the prescribed per-capita norm, with source sustainability measures.

application.steps: Requested through the Gram Panchayat or Public Water System; progress tracked on the JJM dashboard.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional delivery.

eligibility.criteria: Pregnant women delivering in government or accredited facilities.

benefits.details: ₹1,400 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban) in low-performing states; ₹700 and ₹600 in others.

application.steps: Register at the health facility or through an ASHA.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Remove out-of-pocket expense for institutional delivery and sick-newborn care.

eligibility.criteria: All pregnant women delivering in public facilities.

benefits.details: Free delivery, C-section, drugs, diagnostics, diet, blood and transport.

application.steps: Available at public health facilities.

sources.title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram — official portal

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
objectives: Give farmers timely short-term credit for cultivation and allied activities.

eligibility.criteria: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers and allied-sector farmers.

benefits.details: Interest subvention on loans; collateral-free limit raised; limit raised to ₹5 lakh in Budget 2025-26.

application.steps: Apply at any bank branch or through the PM-KISAN KCC drive.

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Enable women SHG members to earn a sustainable household income of at least ₹1 lakh per year through livelihood activities.
targetBeneficiaries: Women members of Self Help Groups

eligibility.criteria: Women who are members of SHGs under DAY-NRLM.

benefits.details: Skilling, SHG credit linkage and market access to raise household income to ₹1 lakh or more annually.

application.steps: Join or form an SHG through the state rural livelihood mission or block office.

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
objectives: Small savings instrument for women and girls.

eligibility.criteria: Any woman or guardian of a girl.

benefits.details: Maximum deposit ₹2 lakh over two years.

application.steps: Open an account.

sources.title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate — official portal

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Enhance livelihood security in rural areas by guaranteeing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer unskilled manual work.

eligibility.criteria: Any rural household whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work; registration is through the Gram Panchayat.

benefits.summary: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per household per year
benefits.details: Statutory entitlement; unemployment allowance payable if work is not provided within 15 days of demand.

application.steps: Apply for a Job Card at the Gram Panchayat, then submit a written/online work demand to the Panchayat.

sources.title: Business Standard — VB-G RAM G notification

statusNote: Repealed and replaced by the VB-G RAM G Act with effect from 2026-07-01 (125 days, 60:40 cost sharing).

name: Mission Indradhanush
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Immunise children and pregnant women against vaccine-preventable diseases.

eligibility.criteria: Unvaccinated or partially vaccinated children and pregnant women.

benefits.details: Special drives for left-out and dropped-out beneficiaries.

application.steps: Visit the nearest health centre or immunisation session.

name: Mission Shakti
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
objectives: Empower women through safety, security and enabling services.

eligibility.criteria: All women and girls.

benefits.details: One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181, Mahila Shakti Kendras, Shakti Sadan and Sakhi Niwas.

application.steps: Call 181 or visit a One Stop Centre.

name: Namo Drone Didi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Provide agricultural drones to women SHGs.

eligibility.criteria: Selected women SHGs.

benefits.details: Up to ₹8 lakh per drone.

application.steps: Through the cluster-level federation.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
objectives: Promote apprenticeship training by supporting employers.

eligibility.criteria: Persons eligible for apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act.

benefits.details: 25% of stipend reimbursed to employers up to ₹1,500 a month.

application.steps: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal.

sources.title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme — official portal

name: National Health Mission (NHM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Provide accessible and affordable healthcare across rural and urban areas.

eligibility.criteria: All citizens at public facilities.

benefits.details: Free drugs, diagnostics, ASHA workers and health infrastructure support.

application.steps: Visit public health facilities.

statusNote: Combines the National Rural Health Mission (2005) and National Urban Health Mission (2013).

name: National Pension System (NPS)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
objectives: Provide market-linked retirement savings for employees and citizens.

eligibility.criteria: All citizens aged 18-70 (open to all citizens since 2009).

benefits.details: Tier-I account with tax benefits; partial withdrawals and mandatory annuity purchase at exit.

application.steps: Open an account via eNPS or a point of presence.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
objectives: Provide social assistance to the aged, widows and persons with disabilities living below the poverty line.

eligibility.criteria: Households below the poverty line as per the applicable state/UT norms; components include old-age, widow and disability pensions.

benefits.details: Central assistance under old-age, widow and disability pension components, plus a family benefit on death of the breadwinner.

application.steps: Apply through the local authorities or the state/UT social welfare department; many states accept applications on the NSAP portal.

name: National Food Security Act (NFSA)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
objectives: Provide legal entitlement to subsidised foodgrains.

eligibility.criteria: Households identified by states under priority and Antyodaya categories.

benefits.summary: 5 kg grain per person per month
benefits.details: 35 kg per household for AAY; now free under PMGKAY.

application.steps: Obtain a ration card.

sources.title: National Food Security Act — official portal

name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Provide nutritional support to TB patients.

eligibility.criteria: Notified TB patients on treatment.

benefits.details: ₹1,000 per month during treatment (raised from ₹500 in 2024).

application.steps: Notified at the treatment facility.

name: National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy (NIPUN Bharat)
ministry: Ministry of Education
objectives: Ensure foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3.

eligibility.criteria: Children in Grades 1 to 3.

sources.title: National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy — official portal

benefits.details: Paid for Classes 9 to 12.

application.steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

sources.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme — official portal

name: NPS Vatsalya
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
objectives: Let parents and guardians build a pension corpus for minors that converts to a regular NPS account at age 18.

eligibility.criteria: Any Indian citizen under 18, with a guardian opening the account.

benefits.details: Minimum annual contribution ₹1,000, flexible contributions, and automatic migration to the NPS Tier-I account at 18.

application.steps: Open through eNPS, a point of presence bank or post office.

name: One District One Product (ODOP)
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
objectives: Promote one signature product from each district.

eligibility.criteria: Producers in the district's identified product sector.

benefits.details: Common facility centres and training.

application.steps: Through the district industries centre.

sources.title: One District One Product — official portal

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
objectives: Enable ration card portability so beneficiaries, especially migrants, can draw their entitlement from any Fair Price Shop in the country.

eligibility.criteria: Beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act with an Aadhaar-seeded ration card in a participating state/UT.

benefits.details: Draw subsidised/free foodgrain from any ePoS-enabled Fair Price Shop using biometric authentication.

application.steps: No separate application; beneficiaries use their existing ration card at any ePoS-enabled Fair Price Shop.

sources.title: Department of Food and Public Distribution

name: PAHAL (Direct Benefit Transfer for LPG)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
objectives: Transfer LPG subsidy directly to beneficiary bank accounts.

eligibility.criteria: LPG consumers with Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

benefits.details: Subsidy credited to the linked bank account.

application.steps: Link Aadhaar and bank account via the distributor.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Promote organic farming through clusters.

sources.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana — official portal

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Ensure remunerative prices for farmers' produce.

eligibility.criteria: Farmers selling notified oilseeds, pulses and copra.

benefits.details: Price Support, Price Deficiency Payment and Pilot of Private Procurement schemes.

application.steps: Register with the state procurement agency.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan — official portal

name: PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Build health systems and infrastructure for pandemic preparedness.

eligibility.criteria: Public health facilities nationwide.

benefits.details: Health and wellness centres, critical care blocks, labs and surveillance.

application.steps: No individual application.

sources.title: PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission — official portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
objectives: Reduce poverty and improve infrastructure in SC-majority villages.

eligibility.criteria: SC-majority villages and households.

benefits.details: Income generation, adarsh gram and hostel infrastructure.

application.steps: Through the state social welfare department.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana — official portal

name: PM-DAKSH
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
objectives: Skill training for SC, OBC, DNT and sanitation workers.

eligibility.criteria: Target-group youth within income limits.

benefits.details: Short- and long-term training.

application.steps: Register on the PM-DAKSH portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Raise agricultural productivity, storage, irrigation and credit access in 100 low-performing agricultural districts.

eligibility.criteria: Farmers in the 100 districts identified on productivity, cropping intensity and credit indicators.

benefits.details: Targeted investments in irrigation, post-harvest storage, credit and crop diversification.

application.steps: Through district agriculture offices; no separate individual application.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana — official portal

name: PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE)
ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries
objectives: Accelerate EV adoption through demand incentives and charging infrastructure.

eligibility.criteria: Buyers of eligible electric vehicles and fleets.

benefits.details: Support for e-two-wheelers, e-three-wheelers, e-buses and charging stations.

application.steps: Availed at dealerships.

sources.title: PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement — official portal

name: PM eVIDYA
ministry: Ministry of Education
objectives: Unify digital, online and on-air education for school and higher education.

eligibility.criteria: All learners.

benefits.details: DIKSHA, SWAYAM Prabha TV channels, and radio.

application.steps: Access through the DIKSHA portal and app.

name: PM-eBus Sewa
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
objectives: Add 10,000 electric buses in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

eligibility.criteria: Cities covered by the scheme.

benefits.details: Operational support for city bus operators.

application.steps: Through city transport agencies.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
objectives: Provide free foodgrain to beneficiaries to ensure food security during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

eligibility.criteria: Households covered under the National Food Security Act, including Antyodaya Anna Yojana and priority households.

benefits.summary: Free foodgrain per person per month
benefits.details: Additional free grain over and above the NFSA entitlement; extended under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana phase.

application.steps: Avail benefits through the Fair Price Shop using the ration card; no separate application.

sources.title: Department of Food and Public Distribution

statusNote: Extended for a further five years from 2024 under the free-foodgrain phase.

name: PM Internship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
objectives: Provide 12-month paid internship experience in top companies to youth.

eligibility.criteria: Indian citizens aged 21-24 not in full-time employment or education, with family income up to ₹8 lakh and no government job in the family.

benefits.details: ₹4,500 from the Centre and ₹500 from the company; insurance cover included.

application.steps: Register on the PM Internship portal and apply to listed opportunities.

statusNote: Launched as a pilot in October 2024; check the portal for the current full-scale rollout status.

name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN)
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
objectives: Improve socio-economic conditions of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).

eligibility.criteria: PVTG families and habitations identified by states.

benefits.details: Housing, roads, water, power, health, nutrition and education facilities across 11 interventions.

application.steps: Through the district tribal welfare office.

sources.title: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan — official portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Provide direct income support to landholding farmer families to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and household expenses.

eligibility.criteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land. Excludes institutional landholders, income-tax payers, serving/retired government employees, and professionals with monthly pension above the notified limit.

benefits.details: Paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to the bank account via DBT.

application.steps: Register on the PM-KISAN portal with Aadhaar and land records, or apply through a Common Service Centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
objectives: Provide old-age social security to small and marginal farmers through a contributory pension scheme.

eligibility.criteria: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares, aged 18–40, subject to exclusion criteria.

benefits.details: Payable from age 60; the government matches the farmer's monthly contribution.

application.steps: Enrol through a Common Service Centre or the Maandhan portal with Aadhaar and bank details.

name: PM-KUSUM
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
objectives: Provide solar pumps and decentralised solar power to farmers and cut diesel dependence.

eligibility.criteria: Farmers with agricultural land; component-wise eligibility for solar pumps, grid-connected pumps and solar plants.

benefits.details: Typically 30% central and 30% state subsidy, with the farmer paying the balance.

application.steps: Apply through the state nodal agency portal.

statusNote: Original scheme period ended March 2026; check for extension or successor.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
objectives: Provide institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship.

eligibility.criteria: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating micro enterprise.

benefits.details: Categorised as Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000–₹5 lakh) and Tarun (₹5–₹10 lakh), with Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh.

application.steps: Apply directly to a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with the business plan and KYC.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
objectives: Provide free dialysis services at district hospitals.

eligibility.criteria: BPL patients needing dialysis.

benefits.details: Delivered through district hospitals under NHM.

application.steps: Visit the district hospital.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme — official portal

name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
objectives: Improve the nutritional status of school-going children and encourage school attendance and retention.
targetBeneficiaries: Children in government and government-aided schools

eligibility.criteria: Students of Classes I–VIII in government and government-aided schools, and children in identified Balvatika/early classes.

benefits.summary: Free hot cooked meal on school days
benefits.details: Nutritionally balanced meals as per prescribed calorie and protein norms.

application.steps: Delivered automatically to enrolled students in eligible schools; no separate application.

sources.title: Department of School Education and Literacy

statusNote: The erstwhile Mid-Day Meal Scheme was renamed PM POSHAN in 2021.

name: PM Schools for Rising India (PM SHRI)
ministry: Ministry of Education
objectives: Upgrade 14,500+ schools into model NEP-aligned institutions.

eligibility.criteria: Selected government schools.

benefits.details: Better teaching, smart classrooms and green practices.

application.steps: Schools are selected through a challenge method.

sources.title: PM Schools for Rising India — official portal

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
objectives: Install rooftop solar on 1 crore households and provide up to 300 units of free electricity a month.

eligibility.criteria: Indian households with a roof suitable for solar panels, a valid electricity connection and no previous solar subsidy.

benefits.summary: Central financial assistance for rooftop solar
benefits.details: ₹30,000 per kW for up to 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the third kW, capped at ₹78,000, plus concessional loans.

application.steps: Register on the national portal, select a vendor and apply for subsidy after DISCOM inspection.

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

eligibility.criteria: Urban households without a pucca house; income slabs apply to the credit-linked interest subsidy component.

benefits.details: Support across four verticals: in-situ slum redevelopment, affordable housing in partnership, beneficiary-led construction, and interest subsidy on home loans.

application.steps: Apply through the state/UT housing board or the PMAY-U portal as per the applicable vertical.

eligibility.criteria: Urban households without a pucca house anywhere in India, with annual income up to ₹9 lakh (EWS up to ₹3 lakh, LIG ₹3-6 lakh, MIG ₹6-9 lakh).

benefits.summary: Central assistance of ₹2.5 lakh per house
benefits.details: Four verticals: Beneficiary-Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership, Affordable Rental Housing and Interest Subsidy Scheme.

application.steps: Apply on the PMAY-U 2.0 portal or through the urban local body.

benefits.summary: Credit-linked subsidy up to 35% of project cost

application.steps: Apply on the PMEGP e-portal with the project proposal for screening and bank sanction.

benefits.summary: Crop insurance with low farmer premium
benefits.details: Farmer premium capped at 2% (kharif), 1.5% (rabi) and 5% (commercial/horticultural) of sum insured; balance subsidised.

application.steps: Enrol through the PMFBY portal, a bank, or a Common Service Centre before the notified cut-off date.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
